title: Timeline Excerpt Preview
requirements: Implement DiaryStore.excerpt(for entry: DiaryEntry, length: Int = 120) async throws -> String that reads the first `length` characters of the entry's .md transcript; returns "" for missing/empty transcript (not a crash)
Replace the literal "" in EntryRow.excerpt with a lazy-loaded preview from store.excerpt(for:); cache the field on the row view-model to avoid re-reading on each redraw
Show truncated text with an ellipsis (U+2026) when the transcript exceeds the length; fit to ≤1 line in the timeline row
For entries with source .none, the row displays "No transcript yet"
acceptance_criteria: Timeline rows for transcribed entries show a truncated transcript preview at ≤1 line, ~120 chars max
Rows for untranscribed entries (source .none) show "No transcript yet"
Scrolling a 1,000-entry timeline does not re-read every .md on each redraw (cached)
